title: Selection and Appointment of Members in Committee on Future Asatizah
what_it_is: Selection and Appointment of Members in Committee on Future Asatizah

sections.label: COFA selection and asatizah skills
sections.summary: MUIS selected COFA members considering asatizah representation and professionals, with over 400 participants involved.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: Future asatizahs need to be equipped with strong grounding in religious knowledge as well as with work-relevant skills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: In selecting the COFA members, MUIS considered two key factors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: First, COFA needs strong representation from the asatizah fraternity, since its work has a direct impact on asatizahs, as well as from the Malay/Muslim community leaders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: Both senior and young asatizahs, including madrasah leaders, have been appointed to COFA as they offer important perspectives on the key attributes of future asatizahs and how to nurture them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: Second, COFA includes professionals and academics from different fields who can advise on industry trends and continuing education and training in non-religious sectors where asatizahs can contribute, such as in social work and counselling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
sentences.text: More than 400 individuals have participated, including senior asatizahs, representatives from Muslim organisations, Islamic education providers and voluntary welfare organisations, professionals and business owners, academics, youths, Islamic studies undergraduates, madrasah educators, religious officers and members of the mosque fraternity.
